name: @w6w-apps/acuityscheduling
description: Manage Acuity Scheduling appointments, appointment types, calendars, clients and availability.

w6w.longDescription:
Acuity Scheduling handles the booking pages that turn website visitors into calendar appointments, and this app brings that pipeline into a workflow. Create, look up, cancel and reschedule appointments; check open availability before offering a time slot elsewhere; and read back the appointment types, calendars and clients behind a booking.

A common pattern is triggering a workflow off an external event — a form submission, a CRM stage change, a support ticket — and creating the appointment directly, or checking availability before recommending a time. Because Acuity addresses every appointment, calendar and client by a plain numeric ID, these actions are simple lookups and writes rather than multi-step resolution.

This app covers the appointment lifecycle and the read-only data around it; it does not touch payment processing or custom intake-form fields, which stay specific to each Acuity account.
